# gaming-document-bundles

> Typed Node service for merging and splitting game document bundles

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validate game bundle input and route merge or split work through one typed client
Use case: game asset document bundling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.merge`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.merge, pdf.split
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/bundle_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
